description:
Location: Remote hybrid at Huntsville, AL, McLean, VA, or Richmond, VA
Required Clearance: Must be a U.S. citizen
Required Education: HS/GED
Required Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in front-end development, dashboard design, or data visualization platform development.  Preferred 3-5 years’ experience.

Position Description 
PingWind is seeking a Front-End Developer to build and deliver the user experience layer of a highly strategic, federally aligned supply chain resilience initiative. Reporting to engineering leadership, this individual will own dashboards, user experience, and visualization delivery within a live control-tower environment.
The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can drive their work from conception to deployment with minimal supervision. This role requires a developer who is not only proficient in React but also passionate about writing clean, maintainable code and delivering exceptional user experiences, particularly when working with large data sets.
Primary Responsibilities:
Typical Responsibilities/Tasks:
•    Develop and maintain responsive, user-friendly web applications using React.
•    Collaborate with product managers and UX designers to implement innovative solutions.
•    Work closely with backend developers to integrate APIs and ensure seamless data flow.
•    Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability.
•    Conduct thorough testing and debugging to ensure high-quality code, including writing unit tests.
•    Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers.
•    Stay up to date with the latest industry trends and best practices in front-end development.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement of development processes and workflows.
•    Drive projects from initial concept through deployment, ensuring milestones are met on time.
Required Qualifications
•    3–5 years of experience in frontend development, full-stack development, data application development, or related roles.
•    Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+).
•    Hands-on experience with React.
•    Experience with state management libraries such as Redux or MobX.
•    Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design principles.
•    Familiarity with modern front-end build tools (e.g., Webpack, Nx, Babel, NPM).
•    Experience with Git and version control.
•    Familiarity with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and asynchronous request handling.
•    Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Desired Skills
•    Strong understanding of UX/UI principles and the ability to translate complex data into intuitive interfaces.
•    Knowledge of front-end performance optimization techniques.
•    Experience with AI tools and agentic development.
•    Experience with TypeScript and SCSS.
•    Familiarity with Docker, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and CI/CD pipelines.
•    Experience with modern testing frameworks.
About Pingwind
 
PingWind is focused on delivering outstanding services to the federal government. We have extensive experience in the fields of cybersecurity, development, IT infrastructure, supply chain management and other professional services such as system design and continuous improvement. PingWind is a VA CVE certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) and SBA HUBZone Certified with offices in Washington DC and Northern Virginia. www.PingWind.com
 
 
Our benefits include:
 
·       Eleven Federal Holidays
·       Paid Time Off accrued each pay period
·       Parental Leave
·       Three medical plan choices with generous employer contribution
·       Dental and Vision Insurance
·       Company paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
·       Company paid Life and AD&D Insurance
·       401k with competitive matching and vesting schedule
·       Continuing education assistance
·       Short Term / Long Term Disability & Life Insurance
·       Medical, Dependent Care and Commuter Flexible Spending Accounts
·       Employee Assistance Program 
·       Wellness benefits include Calm Health app and WellHub gym subsidy (formerly GymPass)
·       529 College Savings Plan
·       Legal Insurance
·       Pet Insurance
 
Salary Range
$115k-$160K
The pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) job responsibilities, education, certifications, experience, as well as internal equity mapping and alignment with market data, or other applicable laws.
 
Veterans are encouraged to apply
